args.title: Throw IngestError for rows with trailing newlines
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The function assertShape throws an IngestError with the message key 'errors.rowShape' when the row does not match the expected shape. This includes rows that are empty due to trailing newlines at the end of the file.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The function assertShape throws an IngestError with the message key 'errors.rowShape' when the row does not match the expected shape, which will occur for rows that are empty due to trailing newlines at the end of the file.
